catalog.MG_MOTORS: Standalone replacement electric motors, including conveyor drive motors; excludes rollers, gearboxes, and service labor.
catalog.MG_CONVEYOR: Replacement mechanical conveyor rollers only in this pilot; excludes motors, belts, complete conveyors, and services.
catalog.insufficient_evidence: Requested item or alternatives are not resolved; ask the requester.
catalog.mixed_scope: Several kinds of goods or services are requested together; ask to separate scope.
catalog.no_suitable_group: The requested item is identifiable and outside this pilot catalog; buyer review.

identification_options.satisfied: Required evidence is complete, unambiguous, and consistent.
identification_options.missing: Required evidence is absent and no allowed reference supplies it.
identification_options.unclear: Evidence is present but its meaning or selected component remains ambiguous.

identification_rules: Use relevant affirmative facts; ignore negated or explicitly unrelated values. Accept attached units, written-out numbers, 3 ph, 3~, and single-phase. Do not convert hp/PS to kW. For rollers, ØD×L mm means diameter and length; bare D×L mm is ambiguous. Like-for-like evidence may use one selected matching-kind reference component with all required attributes. Resolve multiple candidates using affirmative or negative constraints; do not select by position. Compare selected reference facts with relevant requested facts. Conflict takes precedence over unclear, missing, then satisfied.
